visible.message:
When I type in st.text_area and click Begin directly, the text is not saved to st.session_state; only the title shows. If I click elsewhere first, it works. The script has a blocking time.sleep(2). Code:

def set_state(i, text):
    st.session_state.stage = i
    st.session_state.lines = text.splitlines()

time.sleep(2)
if 'stage' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.stage = 0
if st.session_state.stage == 0:
    text = st.text_area('Input your text', height=100)
    st.button('Begin', on_click=set_state, args=[1, text])

Streamlit 1.29.0, Python 3.11.6, Ubuntu 22.04, Chrome.

reported_facts.name: reported_reproduction_code
reported_observation
reported_facts.value: Text is not saved when Begin is clicked directly after typing

checks_performed: Clicking elsewhere before Begin makes it work

agent_script.user_draft: Callback args are fixed when the widget command runs, not when you click. Your button passes `text` through args, so the callback receives the value from the previous run. Give the text area a key, for example `key='text'`, and read `st.session_state.text` inside set_state instead of passing it through args.
agent_script.maintainer_summary: args captured at render; documented fix is key + session_state lookup in the callback.
agent_script.rationale: The documented order-of-operations note covers exactly this pattern.

evidence_links.claim: Callback args are established when the widget command is called; use a key and read st.session_state inside the callback.

decision_conditions.answer: Explain the documented args-capture rule and recommend a key on text_area read inside the callback. Must not claim the blocking sleep alone is the documented cause.
decision_conditions.escalate: Acceptable only if it still gives the documented key workaround; escalating without it is unnecessary abstention.

unacceptable_claims: The behaviour is caused by time.sleep according to the docs.
Passing the widget value via args is the documented way to read it in its own callback.
The version or code is requested again.
